notes.title: Update #5: Oculus Touch and native OSVR support
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

Just a quick update, we’ve been working on support for Oculus Touch and the OSVR HDK2 over the past couple weeks and we’ve finally have it ready for you guys!

The Oculus Touch controllers will work the exact same way as the Vive wands do within the game and we’ve designed new “Orbs” to fit the look and feel of the Touch controllers.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25786412/f2d713c2bf95bed4e6b14200ec4b35830f8f8ae9.jpg[/img]

We’ve also worked with Razer to get native OSVR support up and running within the game, you’ll now have the option to launch the native OSVR version of the game which will launch the OSVR server directly without the need for any other drivers/software! You can check it out on their official website as well: http://www.osvr.org/featured.html

As always, we’ll keep you posted on new updates to the game!

Happy Holidays,

VitruviusVR Team

notes.title: Update #4- New Weapons and Performance Upgrade
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

Thanks for all your support in the first month of the release! We’ve gotten a lot of feedback and we plan on integrating everything in the coming weeks.

We’ve worked on a small patch to increase the performance of the game for you and have just added 6 new weapons to choose from in the Armory!

Tier 1- Starting Weapons- 0 coins 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25786412/1b9aa355834188c0c03e30e961cb0a383d2f1242.png[/img]

The Mervil Sword: Standard Range & Attack
The Mervil Battle Hammer: Standard Range & Attack
The Mervil Mace: Standard Range & Attack
The Mervil Club: Standard Range & Attack


Tier 2- Light Weapons- 200 Coins ea.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25786412/5024b01c324020c8fb700799e6d6acad550736ca.png[/img]

Halberd of Light- Purple aura brightens dark Mervil World’s
Sword of Light- Green aura brightens dark Mervil World’s


Tier 3- Longer Range Weapons- 800 coins ea.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25786412/5660786bb602933ee094472fa5634704c9b989f6.png[/img]

Mystical Hammer: +30% Attack Range
Legendary Axe: +30% Attack Range


Tier 4- Legendary Weapons- 1000 coins ea.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25786412/ae3d35024201a9914da15d4a58e5d3445cdd9648.png[/img]

Slayer of Evil: +30 % Attack Range and deals 3 Damage
The Great Mervil Sword: +30 % Attack Range and deals 3 Damage

(which means you can one hit kill most of the enemies in the game!)

We hope you enjoy the new weapons and stay tuned for more updates as the Winter Holidays approach!


-VitruviusVR Team

notes.title: Update #2- Balazar's New Voice!
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

Development is going strong and we're hoping to have the full game completed for you to play in the next few weeks! The Arctic World and Paradise Cove will be included along with the new Dark Isles World where you will meet Balazar himself.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25786412/b282e62f3d321dbc2aeac78d666a379cfcacb6c8.jpg[/img]

We've been working with an amazing voice actor "StringStorm" to get Balazar's voice perfect for the upcoming levels. We couldn't be more happy with the final result.

Have a listen here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S_naS7MiEIc
We'll keep you guys posted on updates before the full release and be prepared for a battle against the mighty Balazar!

Cheers,
-VitruviusVR Team

Also you can find more of StringStorm's voiceover work and compositions on his site: http://www.stringstormmusic.com/

notes.title: Update #1- Vive Motion Controller Support
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

Thanks for all your support with Mervils over the past week. We appreciate all the feedback on the game thus far!

The #1 piece of feedback we've been getting is to integrate the Vive motion controllers into the game. We've tried this in the past to no success, but you guys gave us some great ideas over the the past week and we've found a control scheme that works amazingly!

 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25786412/801a0a3424355507e05e38cfb3579687d0348170.jpg[/img]

Here's how the new controls work:

1. The Wand of Teleportation: Allows you to move your character throughout the worlds and teleport (Blink) to his position at any point in time.

2. The Wand of Power: Allows you to jump, open inventory, interact, attack, and set way points to perform difficult platforming maneuvers.

Setting Waypoints:

The most important addition is the setting of way points. This works the same as the "Blink & Teleport" mechanic in first-person Vive games, but instead you are in a third-person view. (You'll need this for the platforming elements in the game!)

Here's a link to a short video guide as well: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L611tEBCXmg

Please let us know what you think of the new controls!

Cheers,
Blake & the VitruviusVR Team
